get.summary: Stream persisted Run progress with live session and organization authorization

200.description: SSE progress: event: progress; id: <run ID>:<persisted version>; data: the same explicit public Run JSON object as GET /runs/{id}, without envelope. Always sends the current snapshot, including terminal reconnects; Last-Event-ID must match the path ID and is not authorization. Heartbeat comments every 10s; session/user/membership/run.read revalidated every 2s with 1s operation/write bounds; one connection at most 5min. Terminal snapshot then EOF. Revocation/failure after headers emits event: error without id and data:{code,request_id}, then EOF. Error codes are MI_SESSION_REQUIRED, MI_PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED, MI_PERMISSION_DENIED, MI_NOT_FOUND, MI_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE. Per-handler/process limits: 64 global, 4 per user; excess handshake returns 429 Retry-After:5. No S2 body, prompt, private variables or credentials; fetch uses same-origin Cookie and organization header, never query credentials.
